L01.drivers: Average slim build; ordinary shoulder-to-hip ratio; normal profile with modest buttock curve

L02.drivers: Average build, slightly broader shoulders; normal proportions

L03.drivers: Broad, heavy-set frame with wide shoulders and thick limbs, still within normal human range; profile shows deep chest

L05.drivers: Very wide, squared shoulders and deep upper chest tapering to a narrow waist and slender legs; long arms; strong V-shape that reads as extreme upper-body build rather than a different anatomy

L06.drivers: Barrel-shaped upper torso with pronounced convex back and chest in profile, pinched waist, narrow sloping shoulders, thin long limbs, and an unusual leg profile with a forward knee bulge and recurved calf line; segment shapes do not match ordinary human variation
axial_cues: barrel chest pinched into narrow waist

L08.drivers: Same structure as L06: barrel upper torso with large convex back, pinched waist, narrow hips, thin limbs, and kinked knee/shin profile

L11.drivers: Moderate belly protrusion and soft torso, typical overweight/older male; proportions otherwise ordinary

L12.drivers: Moderate belly, soft heavy torso; ordinary human overweight variation

groups.label: barrel-torso, pinched-waist, thin-limbed humanoid with kinked knee profile

distinguishing_features: Only one clear non-human group (L06, L08): convex barrel upper torso and back, pinched waist, small pelvis, thin limbs, forward knee bulge and recurved shin line in profile. L05 is the borderline case (very wide shoulders and V-taper); I read it as extreme human (B), but it could be a second, separate kind of body. It does not share the L06/L08 back and leg profile.
